title: Dailybot | Performance and Reliability Updates · Changelog
summary: Significant backend optimizations resulting in 40% faster check-in delivery, improved webhook reliability, and reduced API latency.
body_markdown:
We’ve made significant backend optimizations to improve the speed and reliability of Dailybot. Check-in delivery is now 40% faster, webhook reliability has been improved, and API latency has been reduced across the platform.


These infrastructure improvements ensure that your team gets their check-ins and notifications on time, and that integrations and automations run more reliably.
